content.text: : similar actions as ACEI but binds & blocks the angiotensin II-r – does ⍉increase bradykinin prod
, good for use in pts who cannot take ACEI
Block angiotensin 2 R site -> more completely block angiotensin2 R
Since ⍉ effect bradykinin -> more selective to angiotensin effects
Also like ACEi w DM nephropathy & renal protective
Aortic regurg: afterload reduction (limited role: pre-op or ⍉surgical candidates)
IF ANGIOEDEMA W ACEi, CAN START ARB 6Wk POST ACEi D/C
Also ind: ACEi-induced cough -> switch to ARB
Acute renal failure w B/L renal a. stenosis
⍉ combo w ACEi: dual RAAS blockade ⇡hyperK, hypotension, AKI; no added CV/kidney benefit over monotx
: block-r for angiotensin II on vasc smooth musc, blocking vasoconstrict
in pts w albuminuria (dt/t HTN, DM, and other Eti of CKD)
: first line agent or in combo w/ CCBs or diuretics
•combo w/ diuretics in CVA prev & CHF
: less cough & angioedema, dizziness, HA, rash
